verdicts.reason: A turns the layout into a real left-to-right banner with three columns (can, headline, CTA) and a strong headline. But the GLACIER logo floats centred and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, the circle almost touches the top and bottom of the canvas, and the body copy sits cramped against the bottom edge. B is just the original shrunk into a centred cluster: the headline is small for the format, there are big empty areas on the far left (about 160px) and right (about 180px), the circle and CTA crowd the top and bottom edges, and the SOLSTICE label on the can is unreadably tiny.
